issue_description: From Binney/Galileo southbound, the right-hand lane is marked as "straight-through-or-right-turn" only. But the right-turn signal is on a different phase than the straight-through signal. So every day from 3pm-5pm, I have to listen to air horns every time a truck wants to turn right, but the car in front of it wants to proceed straight. Since the left-hand lane has already been converted into a "straight-through" lane, please make the right-hand lane into a "right-turn-only" lane, and add signage sufficient far back on Binney St to allow vehicles to pick the correct lane.
objective_description: Heading southbound from Binney Street at Galileo Galilei Way, the right-hand lane permits both straight-through and right-turn movements, conflicting with the signal phasing that separates these directions.
